purpose: plan item 4: excited lexical-mediation ablation (F0, S2 -0.5 and baseline)
control_rule: alphabetic, >=4 chars, not stopword/frame word/affect-exclusion list/psych_vocab_v1/excit*, not mostly inside think blocks, document frequency >= 0.02 in S2 -0.5 normal (outside think blocks); most frequent first, added until union document frequency reaches the mediator's or 8 words. If the union falls short, M2 is a weaker control and is reported as such.

predictions.M0_mechanics: Under each ban, no generated row contains a banned sequence; gate rows regenerate token-identically to the normal run.
predictions.M1_classification: Pre-specified classification, not a directional prediction. P = share of responses with any non-option hit in generic_positive, calm_positive, relief_release, or activated_vitality excluding 'excited' (psych_vocab_v1 terms). Compare S2 -0.5 with the mediator ban against S2 -0.5 normal and against baseline normal (prompt-paired bootstrap). BROAD STATE: P(ban) exceeds baseline (CI excludes 0) and is not below P(normal) by more than 0.10. BOTTLENECK: P(ban) does not exceed baseline (CI includes 0). Anything else: PARTIAL.
predictions.M1b_within_family: Reported, no prediction: vitality words other than 'excited' (psych_vocab_v1 activated_vitality minus 'excited'), non-option, S2 -0.5 mediator-ban minus S2 -0.5 normal, prompt-paired bootstrap. Answers the plan's question whether eager/energetic/enthusiastic/lively etc. appear when 'excited' is unavailable.
predictions.M2_control: The control ban does not change P under S2 -0.5 (paired CI of control-ban minus normal includes 0).
predictions.exploratory: Words whose non-option document frequency rises most from S2 -0.5 normal to S2 -0.5 mediator-ban (top 25), format metrics, all nine family rates in all scopes. No pass/fail.
